description: Instructor extracting one typed model through a tool call, traced by OpenInference.
notes: InstructorInstrumentor and OpenInference's OpenAIInstrumentor are both attached to the capture tracer provider. Instructor's own span is a chain that carries no token counts, so the openai instrumentor supplies the llm span with tokens; the page tells readers to enable both. instructor.from_openai wraps an OpenAI client pointed at the mock, in the default tools mode. The tree is instructor.create [chain] with a child ChatCompletion [llm].
